overview.title: Overview
overview.intro: We want you to be satisfied with every purchase. This policy explains how returns and refunds work, including timelines and eligibility requirements.

eligibility.title: Refund Eligibility
eligibility.intro: To be eligible for a refund, please ensure that:
points: The item is unused, in original condition and in original packaging.
The return request is submitted within 14 days of delivery, unless otherwise stated.
Proof of purchase is provided (order number or receipt).
Items marked as final sale or non-returnable are excluded.

howToReturn.title: How to Initiate a Return
steps: Contact our support team with your order number and reason for return.
Ship the item via trackable method; include all original accessories and tags.
After receiving and inspecting the item, we will confirm refund approval or denial.

method.title: Refund Method and Timing
points: Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method.
Processing time is typically 5–10 business days after approval; bank times may vary.
Shipping fees are not refunded unless the return is due to our error or a defective item.

nonRefundable.title: Non-Refundable Items
points: Gift cards and digital items after delivery.
Personalized or custom-made items, unless defective.
Items not in original condition, damaged or with missing parts for reasons not due to our error.
